title: Maximum Element After Decreasing and Rearranging
goal: Maximize the final value after decreases and rearrangement under adjacent-gap constraints.
strategy: Sort and greedily make each position as large as permitted: no greater than its original value or the preceding repaired value plus one. The first position becomes one.
